entry.title: Mobility Suite: Cutting Edge Software and Hardware Combinations
entry.content:
Compatible Devices: Vuzix M4000™ · Vuzix M400™ · Vuzix Shield™ · Vuzix Blade 2™

Cutting Edge Hardware and Software Combinations 

The benefits of wearable computing in logistics and along the supply chain are manifold: hands-free for the job at hand, information stored directly in the wearer’s field of view, and real-time access to inventory systems as is needed.

This access is only possible through an integration between the wearable hardware and the software running on it.

As business needs evolve, it’s the ability to keep software aligned with back-end processes that ensures an agile and adaptive environment that can flex with shifting demands.

Hardware alone is not enough.

It’s for this reason that Vuzix offers the Vuzix Mobility Suite, a full solution integration between your crew’s head-worn hardware and an ecosystem of ancillary devices and software applications.

Vuzix Mobility Suite

While every client’s environment is different, Vuzix has supported customers through hundreds of implementations and use cases. This experience enables us to assemble the right balance of mobility integrations so that you can quickly identify the software and hardware configuration optimal for your use.

Vuzix hardware comes factory-built with functionality designed to promote quick adoption and a host of user preferences within a given environment. Coupled with partner software as needed, your front-line workers stay productive with dynamic deployment options, the latest security updates, straightforward device management, and ongoing support for your team.

From IT and developers in the back office, to pickers and last-mile delivery on the front line, your investment in Vuzix guarantees you’ll get the right software and supporting services needed to move quickly and scale with confidence.

An unparalleled user experience, minimizing the learning curve and enabling workers to hit the ground running.

 

Integrate with Vuzix Developer Tools

Developers can easily create and integrate mobile smart-glasses apps in less time and with less risk.

Vuzix provides a developer center filled with:

  • Knowledge-base articles

  • Detailed SDK documentation

  • Sample code

Additionally, Vuzix offers free developer technical support to answer questions and provide design guidance as needed.

Development can be done using standard Android development tools, such as:

  • Android Studio

  • Microsoft Visual Studio

  • Unity

Enterprise Mobility Development Toolkit

  • Integrate with smart glasses built-in voice control engine

  • Enable a powerful head-worn barcode scanning engine

  • Provide scanning and glass-friendly access to client-side user interface design elements

Built on an Android-based OS, it’s easy to port existing applications to wearables.

Device & Application Management

Vuzix smart glasses integrate with many of the most common Mobile Device Management (MDM) software packages to help you manage large-scale deployments.

Easily install application software, enforce device policies, and perform OS updates, among many other crucial management tasks. Making relevant information easily available, hands-free, makes the frontline worker’s job easier.

Optimized devices and software tools provide workers with a user-friendly experience to streamline tasks and increase productivity.

Designed for Shared-Use Environments

Vuzix smart glasses are meant to be shared by multiple workers. One device can support multiple shifts with hot-swappable batteries, meaning no downtime.

The M-Series glasses can be worn on the left or right eye without the need to reconfiguration. The mounting systems ensure only the head-mounted components contact the user, so the electronics don’t need to be cleaned between uses.

Your employees can start their shift by simply grabbing their glasses and a battery and getting to work.

Empower Your Teams

App Developers & Independent Software Vendors

Easily integrate a variety of applications to reduce deployment details. IT administrators can manage the most common mobile device management (MDM) software packages to manage large-scale deployments.

Easily install application software, enforce device policies, and perform OS updates, among many other crucial management tasks.

Frontline Workers

Hands-free access to critical information makes the frontline workforce safer and more productive. Optimized devices and software tools streamline tasks and increase productivity.

Team Supervisors

Vuzix smart glasses are designed to support multiple shifts with minimal downtime. Devices are easily cleaned between uses, hot-swappable batteries ensure continuous operation, and workers simply grab the glasses, insert a battery, and get to work.

Stay Secure with Vuzix Mobility Suite

Give IT the confidence they need to assure safe and secure device deployment.

  • Regular security update cadence with various deployment options to fit your organization’s needs

  • Software to support on-site deployment servers is available

  • Vuzix cloud-based update servers are available globally

  • Completely offline updates are available when necessary

  • Updates controlled by third-party software or MDM software are supported

  • Migrate to the new OS at your own pace; your software partner can test and certify the latest OS before rollout

Security Features

Vuzix Home Base

Even without an MDM, Vuzix allows your organization to specify what applications your users can access and even automatically launch apps at startup.

Restricted Mode

Exercise enterprise-level controls over cloud connectivity. Cloud activity is not required, meaning devices can operate fully in an independent environment, completely offline, or on an internal network.

Full Encryption

The OS enables app-level encryption, ensuring devices are fully secure.

Deploy with Vuzix Rollout

Whether it’s one unit or an entire fleet, Vuzix makes rapid deployment possible:

  • Factory configuration customized to your application

  • Fully shareable devices that can be easily swapped out

  • Wi-Fi connectivity options

Training & Onboarding

Onboard with a factory-installed, device-guided setup experience and built-in interactive device training material to help onboard new users with ease.

Device Versatility & Control

Versatility in how you control the unit:

  • Hands-free speech commands

  • Touchpad input

  • Physical buttons

  • Head tracking

  • Hand gestures

Remote Communication

We support remote communication with workers via various conferencing apps. Hands-free, remote communication between workers enables easy access to real-time data.


Vuzix View

A free, streamlined emulation tool used for training, troubleshooting, and diagnostics.

Optimize with Vuzix Versatility

While every client’s environment is different, Vuzix has supported customers through hundreds of implementations and use cases. This experience enables us to assemble the right balance of mobility integrations so you can quickly identify the software and hardware configuration optimal for your use.

Vuzix hardware comes factory-built with functionality designed to promote quick adoption and a host of user preferences. With partner software as needed, your front-line workers stay productive with dynamic deployment options, the latest security updates, straightforward device management, and ongoing support.

From IT and developers to operations and last-mile delivery on the front line, your investment in Vuzix ensures the right software and supporting services to scale with confidence.

Final Statement

Your hardware interactions will change with your needs. With the right software and configuration, your Vuzix devices will change with you.

From built-in applications, utilities, and tools that are part of the core functionality of the hardware, to optimized software integrations that unleash the power of your current investments, Vuzix Mobility Suite will maximize your experience from deployment to ongoing device management.


Learn more about our MDM solution.
